notes: V44 (CR 702.16e-f). Protection restricts only who may block the protected ATTACKER; a creature with protection from Dragons may itself block a Dragon, and the Dragon's damage to it is prevented. The 6/6 flying Dragon attacks, the Angel blocks: its 5 first-strike lifelink damage marks the Dragon (seat 0 gains 5), the Dragon's 6 is prevented, both live. Before V44 a blocker-side veto kept the Angel from blocking at all, and seat 0 took 6 (14).
